verdict.rationale: Apify is a web-scraping and crawling platform, so a fast URL-discovery capability is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence pack documents no map, sitemap, or URL-discovery feature that works without crawling. The only related evidence (apify/web-scraper with startUrls and maxCrawlPages) describes a capped crawl, which is the opposite of discovering URLs without crawling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it
